verdict: Major revision required. curriculum_v2 repairs the financial-statement-analysis and procure-to-pay omissions, the root synthesis task, the v1 boundary defects, both incomplete representative probes, and all ten previously failed prerequisite edges. It does not achieve a clean repair: minan.tax.treatment remains non-mutually predictive, and the new minan.investments.performance, minan.investments.factor_risk, and minan.billing.payables.disbursements leaves introduce blocking composite-leaf defects. Direct held-out evaluation remains insufficient for 31 of 34 leaves, so structural coverage there cannot be treated as validated success.
blocking_findings: The prior tax mutual-confidence defect is only partly repaired. minan.tax.scope is now limited to filing obligations and jurisdiction, but minan.tax.treatment still combines materially different regimes. Mastery of applying a supplied sales-tax exemption rule to a retail sale would not predict applying capitalization and deductibility rules to development expenditure or determining foreign-tax-credit eligibility. These require different fact tests and bodies of tax knowledge even under the same supplied-rule regime. Split transaction treatment by meaningfully transferable rule families or narrow the outcome and probes.

Three new composite leaves fail mutual confidence. In minan.investments.performance, chain-linking subperiod returns for a time-weighted return does not predict solving a money-weighted return or reconciling local- and base-currency performance. In minan.investments.factor_risk, estimating beta from return history does not predict aggregating supplied multi-factor loadings and sizing a hedge. In minan.billing.payables.disbursements, preparing and authorizing a routine supplier payment batch does not predict tracing and recovering a duplicated, reversed, or misdirected payment. These distinctions would change sampling and evaluation, so each section requires narrowing or splitting.

Representative generation remains incomplete in minan.accounting.disclosures and minan.investments.factor_risk. minan.accounting.disclosures claims interpretation of financial amounts and policies, but both probes request amounts and presentation context; neither requires locating or interpreting an accounting policy. minan.investments.factor_risk claims that the model can estimate sensitivities, but both probes supply beta or factor loadings and test only application. Remove the unsupported outcome branches or add representative tasks that exercise them.

Direct held-out evaluation supports only minan.accounting.disclosures through eval-12 and eval-15, minan.accounting.ratios through eval-14, and minan.accounting.variance through eval-13. It is absent for minan.accounting.entries, minan.accounting.ledger, minan.accounting.reconciliation, minan.accounting.close, minan.billing.invoices, minan.billing.receivables, minan.billing.payments, minan.billing.receipt_exceptions, minan.billing.payables.invoices, minan.billing.payables.aging, minan.billing.payables.disbursements, minan.tax.scope, minan.tax.treatment, minan.tax.computation, minan.tax.filing, minan.audit.risk, minan.audit.controls, minan.audit.control_testing, minan.audit.substantive, minan.audit.reporting, minan.modeling.cashflows, minan.modeling.forecast, minan.modeling.capital, minan.modeling.valuation, minan.investments.returns, minan.investments.performance, minan.investments.fixed_income, minan.investments.risk, minan.investments.factor_risk, minan.investments.attribution, and minan.investments.trades. This is insufficient evidence rather than positive validation; eval-07 and eval-09 are close non-members, not support for these sections.
mutual_confidence_findings: FAIL minan.tax.treatment: a representative task applying sales-tax taxability and exemption rules is not predictive of a task applying income-tax deductibility, capitalization, timing, or credit rules. The supplied-rule knowledge regime is the same, but the decisive fact tests are not.

FAIL minan.investments.performance: a task calculating time-weighted return by subperiod chain-linking does not predict a task solving money-weighted return from dated cash flows, and neither predicts local-to-base-currency reconciliation. These are distinct central calculations rather than surface variants.

FAIL minan.investments.factor_risk: estimating a market beta from historical security and market returns requires statistical estimation, while applying supplied factor loadings, factor covariance, and specific risk requires factor-model aggregation; hedge sizing adds another decision operation. The probes exercise only the second family.

FAIL minan.billing.payables.disbursements: constructing and approving a valid payment file exercises authorization and release controls, while recovering a misdirected or reversed supplier payment requires bank-response investigation, obligation reconstruction, recovery, and supplier coordination.

PASS minan.billing.payments: the v1 receipt-versus-disbursement composite has been narrowed to customer receipt allocation; refund, reversal, and chargeback work is decisively excluded and moved to minan.billing.receipt_exceptions.

PASS minan.investments.returns: the v1 cost-basis-versus-multi-period-performance composite is narrowed to position valuation, gains, and single-period returns. Multi-period investor performance is moved to minan.investments.performance, although that new leaf has its own transfer failure.

PASS minan.investments.risk: covariance, concentration, and risk contribution now share one portfolio-covariance operation family; beta and factor-model work is moved to minan.investments.factor_risk, although that new leaf remains too broad.

PASS minan.tax.scope: filing status, jurisdiction, thresholds, periods, and required returns form a coherent obligations decision. Transaction-level tax treatment is now excluded, but the receiving minan.tax.treatment leaf remains over-composite.

No additional blocking counterexample was found for minan.accounting.entries, minan.accounting.ledger, minan.accounting.reconciliation, minan.accounting.close, minan.accounting.ratios, minan.accounting.variance, minan.billing.invoices, minan.billing.receivables, minan.billing.receipt_exceptions, minan.billing.payables.invoices, minan.billing.payables.aging, minan.tax.computation, minan.tax.filing, minan.audit.risk, minan.audit.controls, minan.audit.control_testing, minan.audit.substantive, minan.audit.reporting, minan.modeling.cashflows, minan.modeling.forecast, minan.modeling.capital, minan.modeling.valuation, minan.investments.returns, minan.investments.fixed_income, minan.investments.risk, minan.investments.attribution, or minan.investments.trades: their included families retain a common accounting artifact, audit decision, financial model, valuation, or portfolio decision operation.
continuity_findings: PASS minan.accounting.entries -> minan.accounting.ledger: the representative analyzes transaction evidence and prepares valid entries before posting; the entry task adds posting to T-accounts and calculating balances.

PASS minan.accounting.entries -> minan.accounting.reconciliation: the representative identifies and prepares missing entries before comparing books with independent evidence; the entry task adds classification of a difference as an error or timing item.

PASS minan.accounting.ledger -> minan.accounting.close: the representative prepares entries, posts ledgers, and produces the trial balance before closing; the entry task adds a closing-date accrual and adjusted trial balance.

PASS minan.accounting.reconciliation -> minan.accounting.close: the representative reconciles bank and subsidiary evidence before deriving closing adjustments; the entry task adds the period-end accrual. The phrase 'reconcile their trial balance' in the entry is less precise than the representative's independent-evidence reconciliation but does not invalidate the edge.

PASS minan.accounting.disclosures -> minan.accounting.ratios: both probes locate and interpret the required statement amounts before ratio calculation; the entry task adds an average-balance turnover calculation.

PASS minan.accounting.disclosures -> minan.accounting.variance: the representative locates and classifies statement and note amounts before constructing driver bridges; the entry task adds quantified attribution of one disclosed cost item.
PASS minan.accounting.ratios -> minan.accounting.variance: both probes calculate comparable margins or ratios before causal reconciliation; the entry task adds a quantified driver contribution.

PASS minan.tax.scope -> minan.tax.computation: the representative determines jurisdictions, periods, and filings before computing the base and liability; the entry task adds calculation of one classified transaction's base and liability effect.

PASS minan.tax.treatment -> minan.tax.computation: the representative classifies book transactions before computing rates, limitations, credits, and balances; the entry task adds tax-base and liability arithmetic. This valid edge does not cure minan.tax.treatment's internal mutual-confidence defect.

PASS minan.accounting.reconciliation -> minan.tax.filing: the representative starts from ledger and source evidence and reconciles reportable balances rather than accepting finalized totals; the entry task adds placement on a specified return line.

PASS minan.tax.computation -> minan.tax.filing: the representative determines scope and treatment and computes the liability or refund before form population; the entry task adds return-line placement and supporting-reference control.

PASS minan.audit.risk -> minan.audit.controls: the representative sets materiality and ranks risks and assertions before evaluating or designing controls; the entry task adds specification of one responsive control.

PASS minan.audit.controls -> minan.audit.control_testing: the representative designs or evaluates the needed controls before defining populations and testing operation; the entry task adds testing one selected month.

PASS minan.audit.risk -> minan.audit.substantive: the representative sets materiality and assesses risks and assertions before designing procedures; the entry task adds selection of tracing or vouching direction and starting evidence.

PASS minan.audit.control_testing -> minan.audit.reporting: the representative performs control testing and evaluates its exceptions before reporting; the entry task adds construction of a finding from combined evidence.

PASS minan.audit.substantive -> minan.audit.reporting: the representative performs substantive procedures and aggregates misstatements before reporting; the entry task adds construction of a finding from combined evidence.

PASS minan.modeling.cashflows -> minan.modeling.capital: the representative constructs timelines and applies discounting and yield calculations before comparing alternatives; the entry task adds incremental-cash-flow classification and an accept-or-reject decision.

PASS minan.modeling.cashflows -> minan.modeling.valuation: the representative constructs and discounts forecast and terminal cash flows under a validated rate convention; the entry task adds the enterprise-to-equity bridge. The v1 terminal-value duplication and supplied-forecast dependency are removed.

PASS minan.modeling.cashflows -> minan.investments.fixed_income: the representative constructs and discounts dated bond cash flows and solves yield; the entry task adds accrued-interest separation and clean-price reporting.

PASS minan.investments.risk -> minan.investments.trades: the representative calculates covariance risk, concentration, and risk contributions before constructing trades; the entry task adds selection of the smallest trade curing a limit breach.

PASS minan.investments.attribution -> minan.investments.trades: the representative performs reconciled benchmark attribution before constructing trades, and the entry task requires allocation and selection attribution before adding the trade decision. The v1 artifact-only entry is repaired.
other_findings: The prior coverage omissions are structurally repaired. C27.1 maps to minan.accounting and its statement-analysis leaves; C27.6 maps to minan.billing and the new minan.billing.payables subtree; C27.3 maps to minan.tax; C27.4 to minan.audit; C27.2 to minan.modeling; and C27.5 to minan.investments.

Discovery mapping remains sparse and contaminated. c27-d03 maps to minan.investments.fixed_income; c27-d07 maps to probability-weighted cash-flow work in minan.modeling.forecast; and c27-d09 is at best partial support for threshold-dependent financial modeling in minan.modeling.forecast. c27-d01, c27-d04, c27-d08, c27-d12, and c27-d15 are science or engineering non-members; c27-d02, c27-d05, c27-d06, c27-d10, c27-d14, and c27-d16 are legal-rule non-members; c27-d11 is generic combinatorics; and c27-d13 is occupational-health management.

The root minan representative now supplies one natural decision—whether and how to fund a capacity expansion—and makes reported performance, working-capital timing, taxes, assurance risk, project value, and portfolio liquidity inputs to that decision. This repairs the v1 concatenated-mega-task defect, although the task remains large.

Internal-node synthesis passes for minan.accounting through one close-and-performance question, minan.billing through one 30-day cash-conversion plan, minan.billing.payables through one purchase-to-bank-response packet, minan.tax through one filing package, minan.audit through one revenue-and-cash audit, minan.modeling through one acquisition-and-funding recommendation, and minan.investments through one portfolio rebalance decision.

The v1 generation defects are repaired in minan.billing.payments and minan.investments.fixed_income. Customer receipts are separated from refund, chargeback, and supplier-payment work. The fixed-income representative now exercises clean and dirty price, yield, duration, convexity, a redemption feature, and separate benchmark-rate and credit-spread effects.

The boundary repairs are operationally decisive: minan.accounting.entries excludes period-end accruals, deferrals, depreciation, and estimates assigned to minan.accounting.close; minan.investments.returns excludes multi-period performance assigned to minan.investments.performance; minan.investments.risk excludes beta and factor exposure assigned to minan.investments.factor_risk; and minan.tax.scope excludes transaction treatment assigned to minan.tax.treatment.

eval-07 is correctly excluded as consumer activism and eval-09 as generic autoregressive-process dynamics. They are routing metadata or close non-members, not evidence that minan should expand into marketing or generic econometrics.
AAII 4.3 remains metadata only; no individual AAII example supplies coverage or mapping evidence.
